snapshot: WHO Region of the Americas (PAHO). Universal public health system (SUS) serving more than 200 million people; Fiocruz is a major research and South-South cooperation actor. WHO Director-General Tedros called the SUS a global example in July 2026.

agenda.title: Strengthening the SUS and waiting times
agenda.text: Padilha's main stated goal is shorter waiting times in the SUS. In July 2026 President Lula and Padilha presented the revitalisation of federal hospitals in Rio de Janeiro, which are meant to become centres of excellence.

agenda.title: Disease elimination and WHO cooperation
agenda.text: During Tedros's visit on 27 July 2026, Brazil launched the dossier to start international certification for eliminating mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B. The visit also covered stronger WHO-Brazil cooperation and the work with Fiocruz.

agenda.title: Global health diplomacy
agenda.text: Brazil took a prominent role in negotiating the WHO pandemic agreement, according to the minister, and cooperates with India on medicines, digital health and traditional medicine.
